content.text:
Finding submitted: **deviation** on LOL-CAP.

- **What we found:** Section 15 is headed "Limitation of Garman's Liability" but contains no aggregate monetary cap at all (no "exceed" or "aggregate liability" language anywhere in the document), leaving both parties' direct-damages exposure unlimited. The mutual consequential-damages exclusion and the carve-out for breaches of Sections 13 (IP indemnity, including Garman's indemnity at p0090) and 14 (confidentiality) already satisfy the fallback indemnification and confidentiality carve-outs.
- **Why actionable:** No cap plus no gross negligence / wilful misconduct exclusions fails the fallback on material terms.
- **Cure (fallback, single insertion in Section 15):** mutual cap at twelve months' fees paid or payable by Sparkling, and gross negligence / wilful misconduct added to the Section 15 exclusions — placed inside Section 15 so the existing Sections 13/14 carve-out continues to reach the new cap. We did not volunteer the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor or the additional preferred carve-outs.
